description: Computes the lump-sum capital whose yield alone covers a recurring monthly bill forever, using a TVL-weighted blended rate of railed pools (or a caller-supplied APY between 0 and 1000 percent).

apy.description: Optional annual rate percent, greater than 0 and at most 1000. When omitted, uses the TVL-weighted blended rate of railed pools.

monthly.description: Positive USD/month the capital must cover

name: forever_number
